title: An archived tier cannot take customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Customers — View'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A shows among the archived rows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens on the Pricing tab.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab has no Manage Customers button.
  • It offers Reactivate Tier instead.
